name: The Sponge
description: Supposedly made from the remains of a rare sea creature. It never seems to dry out.

name: Crow-shaped Amulet
description: Ask a question of the dead; add a Fatigue each time. Petty.

name: The Order's note (the paper)
description: Dropped by a jackdaw on the road from Hearth.

name: Rebirth Ash
description: Remnants of a bark spirit. Sprinkle to reignite a fire that has died, or return to life a creature that died only moments before. 3 uses.

name: The Hanged Man's Candle
description: Found in a rotted pack in a protected leather pouch, on the remains outside Mouldy Manor.

name: The sealed letter
description: Eivlyn's petty letter for the Lord of Winter.

name: Heartseed
description: Saved from the roots of a dying tree after hunting the malicious forest spirit that poisoned a homestead. Plant it to create a new forest.

name: Fermented Spirits
description: Keeps you warm at the best of times, and can be used as an explosive at the worst. 3 uses.
